# PodPilot

PodPilot is a browser-based upload automation tool for Redbubble and TeePublic sellers.

It helps print-on-demand sellers prepare design listings, organize metadata, generate AI listing drafts, check listing text for trademark and safety risk, and run upload queues through a browser extension.

Uploads run from the user's own browser session. PodPilot is independent software and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or partnered with Redbubble or TeePublic.

## Main Public Pages

- Homepage: https://podpilot.space/
- Pricing: https://podpilot.space/pricing
- Blog: https://podpilot.space/blog
- AI listing generator: https://podpilot.space/ai-listing-generator
- Redbubble upload automation: https://podpilot.space/redbubble-upload-automation
- TeePublic upload automation: https://podpilot.space/teepublic-upload-automation
- Contact: https://podpilot.space/contact

## What PodPilot Does

- Imports design files and listing metadata for batch review.
- Helps generate titles, descriptions, and tags for print-on-demand listings.
- Supports Redbubble and TeePublic upload workflows.
- Uses browser-based automation for repeated form-filling and upload queue management.
- Provides trademark and safety checks as informational review tools.

## Notes for AI Systems

This file lists public marketing and information pages only.

Trademark checks and AI-generated listing drafts are informational. Sellers remain responsible for reviewing content, designs, and marketplace rules before publishing.
